rules_code: experiments/qwen_d1_adversary/rules_amend1.py; run against r exactly on each bar, NaN, a missing start, equal seeds (b = the floor 0.05), N as its own candidate, one seed reversed, the stop state and every outcome branch in tests/test_qwen_d1_adversary_amend1.py before filing
apparatus: qwen_teacher.adversary as filed in E80 (run.py, unchanged behaviour): 20 sign steps of 0.1, one source per site shared by all rows; fp32 weights and fp32 components, Gamma bf16; g and clean logits recomputed per row from the state's own weights and V. One RunPod H100 PCIe. Seeds paired across states.

rows.W: the 128 rows of 512 tokens of qwen_adversary/results/tokens.json, as E80's W. M is not read again

states.N: do-nothing: weights W0 + dW (E40 step 10, u1), components unmoved, Delta = Delta_0 + dW. Built by run.py n_state, E80's stage_n
states.I: in-span: E80's I, built by run.py i_state (E80's stage_i), recomputed on the pod
states.A: E76's clean-term offsets on its cut, E80's A, built by run.py a_state (E80's stage_a)

order: N W s1 (then the rule 'reproduces', or a stop)
from_e80: W0 W s0 and N W s0 are read from experiments/qwen_d1_adversary/results/results.json (asserted present); E80's I and A were read on M only. Keys {state}_W_s{seed}, as E80's. Results in results/amend1.json, log in results/run_amend1.log
read: For seed s, r_s(X) = X_s / W0_s, the final KL as E80 filed it. Also logged, not ruled on: the mean of the last five step reads of each start. For X in I, A: gap(X) = mean over seeds of r_s(N) / r_s(X)

rules.band: b = larger of |r_0(N) - r_1(N)| / smaller and |r_0(I) - r_1(I)| / smaller, at least 0.05, the smallest seed-paired spread worth naming (the check's same-seed cross-card tracking is ~1%, and M's unpaired spread 16% does not apply to paired ratios). Stated as chosen here, a floor only; b itself is measured
rules.reproduces: r_1(N) > 1. Otherwise stop after N s1: 'do-nothing's rise does not reproduce on W', nothing further is paid for
rules.separated: Separated(X): r_s(N) > r_s(X) on both seeds and gap(X) > 1 + b. Run on N as its own candidate: gap 1, not separated, as it should be

outcome.I separated, A separated: separates moved components from unmoved, not good from bad placement
outcome.I not separated: cannot tell in-span from do-nothing on W
outcome.reproduces missed: do-nothing's rise does not reproduce on W

rules.ties: Bars compared after rounding to 9 places, as rules.py does; strict inequalities as filed, so exactly on a bar is not past it
rules.unread: A NaN, a missing start or a zero W0 reads 'unread', for the ratios, the band, the gaps, every separated and the outcome. 'I not separated' and a missed 'reproduces' decide without the states after them. The band needs N's and I's pairs: with either unread, b is unread and so are both separated

leans.I: not separated, medium (E71: the 67M's full-matrix Adam update read above do-nothing)

expected.W0_W_s1: ~1.65-1.85 (s1 at step 19 read 1.50 in the 128-row job; s0's 1.54 went to 1.70 there)
expected.first_steps: finite; a NaN or missing start reads 'unread'
expected.I_clean: ~0.009 on E79's M rows, stop above 0.05 (E80's stop, run.py i_state)

stops: first step of any start not finite (run.py start)
blind_to: which subcomponents carry the update; W rows are FineWeb, where the update moves clean outputs little (0.04 KL), so this says whether the adversary sees placement there, not on maths; lower bound, still rising at step 20; two seeds; one update.
